column4: dialect-gated: cleat#1986's test-go/support job (ci.yml matrix entry "support", ./plugin/... ./pluginapi/... ./auth/... ./migration/... ./migrations/... ./monitoring/... ./packaging/...) runs with only PostgreSQL configured, so TestSetTenantAllowsPublicExposure's mysql and mssql dialect arms both skip here while postgres runs. Measured by name: go test ./auth/ -run '^TestSetTenantAllowsPublicExposure$' -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly two skips, .../mysql and .../mssql.
Same shape as the line above, for the sibling test. Separate line because check-skip-budget.sh's specific lines are matched by exact pattern, not merged across tests with a shared prefix.

dialect-gated: the cluster job (ci.yml, ./engine/... with only CLEAT_TEST_DB set) runs Postgres and skips SQL Server. This test iterates only {postgres, mssql} (engine.TenantExposurePolicyReader is not implemented for MySQL, D1), so its mssql arm skips here while postgres runs. Measured by name on the cluster job's shape (only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set): go test ./engine/ -run '^TestATenantWithNoGrantMayNotDeployPublic$' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly one skip, .../mssql.

Pairing line for the cluster entry above, required by scripts/check-skip-ledger-engine-coverage.py (cleat#2155): engine-race.yml is the only job that checks this key, and it sets CLEAT_TEST_DB (Postgres) only -- no CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, no CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL -- the same shape as the cluster job rather than a rotation across dialects, so the count matches exactly.
